kind: Preserved diagnostic interposition and transparent source-adapter sampling, distinct from uninstrumented acceptance.

unsettled.kind: Native-only diagnostic interposition on clean GNU binary; logs actual stat/lstat/fstatat/fstat/open/read/futimens requests on fd3, preserving return/errno. Metadata first, no content reads after ancient utimes and before launch. Not acceptance or product native fallback.

settled.kind: Diagnostic native call trace with 500ms settling BEFORE ancient utimes; no content reads after reset before launch; both source and target metadata captured before verification.

paired.kind: Paired diagnostic sampling trace, not uninstrumented acceptance. Native logs actual source stat/open/fstat/read and futimens request; source adapter wraps canonical descriptor.stat and utimes only to record returned/requested metadata, preserving operations. Metadata before all fixture content reads, both source and target.
